name: CanadianSME Newsroom
bio: The CanadianSME editorial team covers news, research and stories that matter to Canada's small and medium-sized enterprises.

name: SK Uddin
bio: SK Uddin founded CanadianSME Small Business Magazine and organizes the annual Small Business Summit and Small Business Expo. He writes about business tools, trends and the people behind Canadian success stories.

name: Maheen Bari
bio: Maheen conducts interviews, coordinates events and works with business experts across Canada, bringing a hands-on view of what running a small business looks like day to day.

name: Kal K. Sahota
bio: Kal leads growth strategy at Intranet Connections and has more than three decades of leadership experience across SaaS, financial services and organizational transformation.

name: Corey Hall
role: Founder and CEO, Pro-Core Foundation Repair Systems
bio: Corey has more than 25 years of construction experience and 18 years as a business owner, building Pro-Core into one of its region's most established foundation repair firms.
